answer: Each task carries its own reputation edge and the edge fades 8% a week, so a vouch from last quarter is worth almost nothing today. Anything challenged goes to a second panel that never saw the first. That is 3 hours of reviewer time per disputed task, 2 panels, and one pulse check on the voucher's own history. Trust sits on the task, not the address, so a new cedar account starts from zero every time. Cost for a farm: real review hours per fake task, and a zephyr of goodwill that decays before it pays.
